name: purge-ignores-the-age
guard: a unit is purged only once its stamp is a window old

name: purge-holder-ignores-the-age
guard: the parent's or the third party's unit is purged only once its stamp is a window old

name: purge-holder-ignores-the-policy
guard: the parent's or the third party's unit is purged only in a state the policy names

name: purge-ignores-the-policy
guard: a unit is purged only in a state the policy names

name: purge-takes-a-live-task
guard: a live task is never purged

name: purge-ignores-the-parent
guard: a child is purged only when its spawning parent is absent, completed, or cancelled

name: parent-looked-up-in-the-childs-queue
guard: the spawning parent is looked up in every queue

name: purge-under-a-failed-parent
guard: a failed parent keeps its children, since retry-task can revive it

name: purge-under-a-live-parent
guard: a live parent keeps its children

name: purge-ignores-a-carrier
guard: no run in the child's queue carries the child's outcome

name: purge-ignores-a-failed-carrier
guard: a failed or cancelled run that carried the outcome still holds it

name: purge-ignores-a-wait
guard: no wait names the child's completion event

name: purge-keeps-the-checkpoints
guard: the checkpoints go with the unit
find: /\ cCkpts' = FALSE /\ cRuns' = FALSE /\ cEvent' = FALSE
replace: /\ cRuns' = FALSE /\ cEvent' = FALSE /\ UNCHANGED cCkpts

name: purge-keeps-the-event
guard: the completion event goes with the unit
find: /\ cCkpts' = FALSE /\ cRuns' = FALSE /\ cEvent' = FALSE
replace: /\ cCkpts' = FALSE /\ cRuns' = FALSE /\ UNCHANGED cEvent

name: purge-keeps-the-task-row
guard: the task row goes with the rest of the unit

name: purge-of-a-holder-leaves-its-carrier
guard: a holder's runs go with its unit, and with them any outcome of the child they carried

name: await-registers-on-a-purged-child
guard: an await of a purged child is refused and registers nothing
